sentences.text: Researchers created a 3D cell model by mixing glioblastoma cells with a surrogate cell line representing neural cells using a gel-based technique, then tracked growth, shape, oxygen levels, and reaction to the drug temozolomide for two weeks.

Although the mixed model formed a tight structure that typically indicates resistance to chemotherapy, it showed sensitivity to the drug at all tested doses, including a low dose that had no effect on the single-cell models.
The presence of the neural surrogate cells changed how the tumor cells responded to the chemotherapy drug.
The authors suggest that testing drugs on tumor cells alone might not accurately show how the tumor behaves in the brain, where neural cells are present.
